context: Kenji uses a new tablet to draw; Aoi watches and chats.
purpose: Couple adapting to creative tech together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: This device is really something special, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm, appreciative tone. Leans in slightly to examine it. Soft Kansai accent on the drawl. Not showy — genuine interest settling into the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Soft, genuine admiration. Her eyes follow the light across the surface. Not performing — just noticing something real. Quiet certainty underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Drawing on it is so much easier.
lines.style: Relaxed, almost thinking aloud. Kansai lilt rises gently on the verb. Content without being effusive. The comfort of finding something that works.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Open curiosity — not challenging, genuinely asking. Slight uptick at the end like she's inviting him to explain something she hasn't tried. Warm, attentive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: Paper has its own good points though.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause underneath. Warm Kansai dialect. Not dismissing her question — weighing both sides honestly. Philosophical without being heavy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: So you switch between both, depending?
lines.style: Following his thought, interested in how he works. Soft tone, slightly leaning forward. Not interrogating — asking like she wants to know how he thinks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Settled, content. Kansai warmth in the vowels. Not the end of the conversation — just agreement. Like he's said it before and means it each time.
